rows.grounds: locative of baindava, pertaining to bindu; analyzed as fused form
qualifies bhāge, indicating the right side
locative noun denoting region or division
absolutive expressing prior action of fixing or establishing

items.question: In which region of the bindu should the wise practitioner establish the mind for effective action?
premises: The baindava region includes a right part.
The mind can be deliberately placed in that part.
Prescribed action follows from such placement.
items.inference: Therefore, the wise practitioner should place the mind in the right part of the bindu and then act.
uncertainties: The specific technical function of baindave in this ritual context is not fully explicit.
items.plain_english: Having placed the mind in the right part of the bindu, the wise one should act.
